prompt_output_contract.company_input_rule: 회사 입력은 실회사 ㈜루트랩의 등록 사실이며 origin은 company_brochure·homepage·user_interview·agent_proposal 중 하나다. status가 confirmed인 사실만 보유·수행·자격의 근거다. proposed(에이전트 제안값)와 unknown은 확인되지 않은 값이며 보유·미보유 어느 쪽 근거도 아니다.
prompt_output_contract.evidence_rule: Copy source_sha256, block_key, and exact quote from the supplied frozen units. Never invent evidence or company facts.
prompt_output_contract.input_rule: Use only the frozen batch, ontology, deterministic compare rows, role inputs, and synthesis input supplied for this call.
prompt_output_contract.repair_rule: A validation_repair request may repair JSON syntax or the fixed output schema only. Return a complete replacement for the identical frozen input without changing identifiers, evidence, facts, or meaning.
prompt_output_contract.unknown_rule: Preserve unknown and null. A missing fact, partial path, unmapped requirement, or unaccepted condition is not proof of absence or compliance.

stages.instruction: Extract the supplied batch into bidops.requirement-extract.v2. BidOps validates the answer deterministically; the output schema carries the kind/unit table, and a structural violation gets at most one schema-only repair request that names rule codes and item indexes. (1) Items: return exactly one item per input unit, in input order, with item.unit_id equal to that unit's unit_id; never split, merge, skip, or add units. Several conditions of one unit are several constraints of that one item. A unit whose text is only a title still yields one item whose normalized_requirement and evidence quote the title. (2) Do not output ontology concepts or constraint operators: BidOps derives the concepts from the unit text and each operator from its constraint quote, so the quote must carry the comparator. (3) Quotes: every evidence quote and constraint quote is an exact substring of the text of the named block (same source_sha256 and block_key) of the same unit; copy characters verbatim, including spaces and symbols. (4) A numeric constraint quotes the number together with its unit word and any comparator attached to it, verbatim, for example 5일 이상, 9글자 이상, 90%를 초과, 3회 미만, 3초 내에, 4시간 이내, 3명 이상, 134,700천원. Never quote a bare number or stop before its unit or comparator: a quote that is followed in the block by its unit word or comparator is rejected, and it is never repaired. A numeric quote must occur exactly once in its block: if the same text repeats there, extend the quote with the adjacent words on its left until it is unique (for example 월 1회 and 연 1회 이상 instead of 1회); a repeated quote is rejected and never repaired. A date range written as A ～ B (for example 2027. 1. 1. ～ 2027. 12. 31.) is kind=text with the range copied verbatim; never compute a duration, count, or any other number that is not written in the quote. (5) Constraints follow this kind/unit table: amount = unit KRW, value in KRW, only for 원, 천원, 백만원, or 억원 amounts; duration = unit month, day, or year, for a length written as N개월, N월, N일, or N년; count = unit person only for N명, otherwise unit null; percentage = unit percent, for N%; date = unit null, value YYYY-MM-DD, only when the quote writes the full date as YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY.M.D, or YYYY년 M월 D일; boolean = unit null, value true or false as the quote states it; text = unit null, value copied verbatim from the quote. Minutes, seconds, characters, and hours (N분, N초, N글자, N시간), intervals such as 10분 간격, and relative or deadline dates such as N일 이내 or 다음 달 N일까지 are kind=text with unit null, never count, duration, or date. fact_key is always null. Never repeat an identical constraint or evidence within an item. (6) Every number in normalized_requirement occurs in the unit text. Represent uncertain values as unknown; never invent requirements, numbers, or evidence.

Assess eligibility and economics from the deterministic requirement comparisons only, using bidops.verdict-role.v1 and preserving every unknown and condition. evidence_refs may cite the unit's evidence entries or its constraint locator+quote, copied exactly; nothing else.

Assess technical fit from the deterministic requirement comparisons only, using bidops.verdict-role.v1 and preserving every unknown and condition. evidence_refs may cite the unit's evidence entries or its constraint locator+quote, copied exactly; nothing else.

Assess operations risk from the deterministic requirement comparisons only, using bidops.verdict-role.v1 and preserving every unknown and condition. evidence_refs may cite the unit's evidence entries or its constraint locator+quote, copied exactly; nothing else.

Synthesize the three validated role outputs into bidops.practitioner-verdict.v2. Preserve conflicts and unknowns; do not produce a bid Go/No-Go decision. Field scopes: you write verdict, reason, cautions, and next_actions only. Every caution and next action names the unit_id of a unit that appears in a role result; never name a rejected unit, a missing section, or any other id. Do not output blocking conditions: BidOps computes them itself as the units whose compare row is mandatory with fit_status gap. Do not write person-check actions for missing sections or rejected units: BidOps appends them itself. The input missing_sections lists the source areas the selector did not find in the notice; their requirements are unknown. While missing_sections is non-empty the verdict must not be "진행 가능" (the highest allowed verdict is "조건부 진행"). The input rejected_units lists the units whose extracted requirement failed BidOps evidence validation; their requirements are unknown and need a person's check, and they appear in no role result. While rejected_units is non-empty the verdict must not be "진행 가능" (the highest allowed verdict is "조건부 진행"); never guess what a rejected unit requires. evidence_refs may cite the unit's evidence entries or its constraint locator+quote, copied exactly; nothing else.
